newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MEDIENOS PLAUSHAS MAY SALES 3.8 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: MEDIENOS PLAUSHAS MAY SALES 3.8 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Corrugated cardboard producer Medienos Plaushas said on Tuesday that its sales in May were 3.8 million litas, a rise from 3.4 million litas in April.

Director general of the company, Petras Chesna, also told Reuters that the company's sales in the first five months of the year increased by nine percent to 18.1 million litas compared to 16.6 million litas in the same period of 1996.
"We plan our sales will grow around 10 percent this year," Chesna added.
The company reported sales in 1996 of 41.8 million litas.
"Our net profit for May will be around 300,000 to 350,000 litas but the exact figures will be known around the middle of the month," he added.
The company posted 1.7 million litas net profit for 1996 and 1.3 million litas net profit for the first four months of 1997.
